items.title: Live - One Piece: Zoro Cup
items.body: Compete in the Duos Battle Royale or the Duos Zero Build One Piece: Zoro Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Roronoa Zoro Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Devil Fruits Across the Island
items.body: Rare Devil Fruits have dropped in across the map! Eat the Gum-Gum Fruit to stretch your skills as Luffy, or the Flame-Flame Fruit to come in hot as Ace... just stay away from water.

items.title: Fortune Sprite Variants - November 7
items.body: Set sail for sparkling Sprites from 2-4 PM ET and 9-11 PM ET! Drop in with A$AP Rocky's Shock Rocket and a Self Revive, and find more Fortune Sprite variants across the Island.

items.title: Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits
items.body: When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer! Set sail with Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits and chart a course to uncharted waters.
